identity: Dawnmere feeds the road to Highcourt, but boars, rats and a remarkably confused requisition gang are eating the harvest first.

quests.title: Crop Thieves
quests.text: Small Boars help themselves to our crops in the {name:home_fields} {dir_of:dawnmere:home_fields}, and only during the day. Bring down eight of them. Their yellow names mean they fight back only when struck, which is more courtesy than they show my turnips.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral: they only fight back. Save the meat.

quests.title: The Night Shift
quests.text: When the sun goes down, Large Rats take over the {name:meadows} {zone_area:meadows}. Kill eight of them there after dark. Mind the gaps between them: a squealing rat brings its relatives, and they are never in short supply.
quests.lesson: Night rosters differ from day rosters; rats call nearby rats.

quests.title: The Hedge Has Foxes
quests.text: Young Foxes have moved into the {name:pastures} {zone_area:pastures} and our hens have stopped laying out of sheer nerves. Hunt eight of them by day. Watch for the Aggressive Boars rooting among them: red names start the fight themselves.
quests.lesson: Yellow foxes next to a red minor role: pick your pulls.

quests.title: Five Claws Too Many
quests.text: Monstrous Crabs have claimed the {name:wreck_coast} {dir_from_giver:wreck_coast}, and the fishermen refuse to argue with them. Kill five there by day. After dark the drowned dead walk that shore instead, so plan your trip by the sun.
quests.lesson: Scarce shore target, five only; the shore changes owner at night.

quests.title: Requisition for One Crumb
quests.text: A man calling himself Chief Crumb has been requisitioning our grain from the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}. Defeat seven of his Confused Bandits, then Crumb himself. They keep their post day and night, so pull the chief apart from his collectors if you can.
quests.lesson: A camp pack plus a named normal leader; pull them apart.

quests.title: The Next Sack of Grain
quests.text: Crumb's ledger names a much larger requisition in Goldmead Vale, our own home valley. Take the account to Marta Millward in Goldmead Village; follow the road out of Dawnmere into the vale. Finish whatever you still want to do here first.
quests.lesson: Start zone to home zone handoff.

quests.title: Two Hands, Two Tools
quests.text: Make a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and bring both to me. I will check them and hand you back a working pair. A sword is a fine thing, but it chops firewood very badly.
quests.lesson: Grid tools; handed-in tools are replaced by the reward.

quests.title: A Stone Edge
quests.text: Use your wooden pick on the rock outside town and make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe. Bring both for inspection whenever it suits you; you get the pair back for the ore work ahead.
quests.lesson: Tool progression; check the rock's pick tier.

quests.title: Two Metals, Not One
quests.text: Smelt three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars from the local ore and bring them to me. They go into the town repairs, and you get a Dual Furnace for your own batches. Set it up outside town, where nobody trips over it.
quests.lesson: Ore to bar; bars handed in are consumed.

quests.title: An Edge for the Road
quests.text: Bring me three Bronze Bars, made from fresh copper and tin in your own furnace. The first bars went into the repairs, so do not count them twice. Take this Bronze Pickaxe as your share; the rock beyond Dawnmere is harder than ours.
quests.lesson: Alloys; the Bronze Pickaxe opens the next rock tier.

quests.title: Something Between Sack and Rat
quests.text: Bring me two Rat Fur Patches from the Large Rats in the {name:meadows}; they come out after dark. I need to patch the grain sacks before the rats empty them. Yes, with rat fur. There is a lesson in that somewhere.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot has uses; collect while hunting.

quests.title: A Brush and a Better Supper
quests.text: Bring two Crab Legs from the Monstrous Crabs on the {name:wreck_coast} and one Fox Tail from the Young Foxes in the {name:pastures}. The legs improve supper, and the tail makes a fine brush for the flour shelf. Keep the Crab Eyes for yourself; I only cook what has legs.
quests.lesson: Keep what your enchants need, hand in what they do not.

quests.title: Five Logs, Any Tree
quests.text: Bring me five logs from any tree outside town, by day or night. The oven needs fuelwood, not an argument about which tree is in fashion. Trees inside Dawnmere stay where they are.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; town plants are protected.

quests.title: A Proper Fire
quests.text: Bring five Coal Lumps from the rock outside Dawnmere. Coal goes in the oven's fuel slot and raw food in the cooking slot, which you would be amazed how many people get backwards.
quests.lesson: Gather while you wait for night; the public oven is in town.

quests.title: The Smokehouse Share
quests.text: Bring ten Raw Meat from your hunts to my kitchen. Boars and foxes give it by day, rats after dark, so save what you already carry. Take some of it back cooked; heroes run on supper.
quests.lesson: Earlier hunt loot is useful; raw food cooks in the oven.
